items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire in that direction (never move). E places a bomb (decrements bomb HUD). Space and Q pressed in the torch room with no visible effect; wall hint says ITEM=Space, so it is unconfirmed whether Space/Q ever act. Death: all heart outlines empty, player sprite absent (an earlier death showed a bloodied X-eyed body). Hazard contact can drain 2-3 hearts extremely fast.

TECH X ITEM (observed): collected from the green/white pill floating above the central rock in the two-poop room (earlier also from a red treasure chest). Grants goggles; firing spawns a laser ring ahead in the fire direction that lingers, grinds overlapping targets, then fades. Ring offset is NOT fixed (~130-325px observed), so precise aiming is unreliable; sustained fire ~1-1.5s is needed to damage a target. It destroys brown poop piles (drops a coin), breaks rocks (red crack outlines appear on damaged rocks/chests), and destroyed the two-poop room's central rock without revealing any passage. Laser had no effect on: the golden coin object, the golden wall fixture, the hopper's spiky shell (hopper burst out and cost a heart), and red-lidded/key-locked chests. Damage to the torch-room central chest produced red cracks but it never opened.

COINS (corrected): the small golden '$'-faced round object appearing where a poop pile was destroyed IS A COIN - collected by walking over it (coins 00->01). Collection needs fairly precise overlap; small single nudges work. Laser ignores coins. Faint gold specks/motes seen elsewhere (on rocks, near the bottom door) went uncollected and are likely ambient decoration - distinguish by whether walking over them increments coins.

CHESTS (observed): gray metal chests open by firing into them or by contact once enemies are dead; drops include a heart+bomb orb and a heart. A red heart at full hearts converted into +1 bomb. Torch room's central gray chest embedded in a rock ring: resists contact (no enemies alive) and resists opening by laser; laser cracks the surrounding rocks and the chest, and ring rocks seem to reappear/regenerate; likely key-locked, with keys HUD stuck at 00 all game. Dark chest room: two corner red-lidded chests resisted many laser hits (key/mimic guess); central red chest ringed by white spikes stayed closed; a corner chest contact earlier cost several hearts at once (mimic/spike guess, unconfirmed).

BOMBS (observed): E places at feet; blast damages the player - 0.5s retreat was not enough, retreat far. A bomb inside a rock pocket cleared rocks but cost a heart. Bombing the white spike ring removed no spikes. Bombing cracked/stained right-wall patterns did nothing (likely decorative).

HAZARDS (observed): black spiders in the dark chest room are melee chasers and lethal. White round-faced 'hoppers' in the rock-field room are extremely dangerous: they teleport/phase around the room, ring themselves with spiky gray rocks, and leave green splatter clouds with green blobs that damage on contact. The shell is unstable - a hopper being lasered burst out of its shell and cost a heart, then re-shelled later. Green clouds cost hearts; a contact chain once drained all hearts to death. Corner torches damage on contact. Diagonal rock chains block both straight and diagonal movement; single-axis moves through gaps work much better; when wedged, a pure single-axis escape move into open floor is needed.

TRANSITIONS (observed): bottom gold trapdoors descend when standing fully centered with sustained S; top gold crown hatches warp from centered below with sustained W; dark trapezoid doorways are ordinary connections needing sustained walking and fairly precise centering. Confirmed: tutorial room's TOP trapezoid door -> rock-field room; tutorial bottom trapezoid -> torch room; torch room's TOP alcove -> back to the TUTORIAL room (a loop); torch room bottom gold trapdoor -> two-poop room; two-poop room top crown hatch -> torch room; tutorial right-wall doorway -> dark chest room (requires correct vertical band, roughly y0.47; pushes at other heights failed). Right-wall doorways need the exact vertical band. Correction this run: the rock-field room's BOTTOM trapezoid loops back to the tutorial room, not a new area. In the dark chest room, a sustained left push near the left-wall door marking did return to the tutorial room.

MAP (observed): Tutorial room (MOVE/ATTACK/BOMB/ITEM hints, top and bottom trapezoid doors, right-wall doorway). Bottom -> torch room (central gray chest in rock cluster, four corner torches, brown poop pile, top alcove back to tutorial, bottom gold trapdoor). Bottom -> two-poop room (central rock, two poop piles, floating Tech X pill, top crown hatch to torch room). Tutorial top door -> rock-field room (many gray rocks, golden wall fixture on the left wall ~x0.20,y0.50, white hoppers, bottom trapezoid back to tutorial). Tutorial right doorway -> dark chest room (corner red-lidded chests, spike-ringed central chest, black spiders).

GOLDEN WALL FIXTURE (unresolved): rock-field room, left wall; touching it does nothing; laser has never landed squarely on it; may be key-locked door/container or decorative.

UNEXPLORED: torch room's right-wall doorway (marking ~x0.78,y0.49; several pushes at various heights failed); any top exit in the rock-field room; whether anything opens the two locked chest types; any source of keys (HUD always 00).

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact/laser-opening locked or mimic chests without keys; firing while too close (ring overshoots); bombing spike rings and decorative wall cracks; lingering near hoppers or green clouds at low health; lasering a shelled hopper expecting a kill; assuming an open-looking lane is clear; hugging corner torches; retrying Space/Q when inert; treating laser particles or gold specks as key pickups; repeatedly grinding the torch-room chest (rocks regenerate, chest never opens).

OPEN QUESTIONS: do Space/Q do anything at all; what opens the torch-room central chest and the dark-room red chests; what the golden wall fixture is; whether keys exist anywhere; where health pickups come from (cleared rooms rarely drop hearts; a he
